$comment: Novelty + auto-corroboration thresholds (Kimi design 2026-07-20). ALL knobs live here — the engine hardcodes none, so a cold-client install retunes without touching code. TUNING PASS 1 (2026-07-20, on real pilot pairs): overlap raised to primary and AUTO.S to 0.82 because trigram-Dice-on-raw-strings penalizes legitimate compression (a 6th app writing the SHORT form of an accepted principle is a perfect token subset, O=1.0, but the length gap held S<0.85). Overlap is the reliable subset detector AND a conjunctive co-gate, so weighting it primary matches design intent. Precision preserved: disjoint paraphrase scores ~0.13, nowhere near the 0.82 gate, and AUTO still requires O>=0.60 AND margin>=0.10.
